MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

4. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 22

6. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 15

7. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 12

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 90
   C. 21
   D. 30

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

11. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 16

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 41
   C. 49
   D. 43

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

16. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

17. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

18. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 4
   D. 13

19. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 25

20. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

26. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

27. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

28. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 25

29. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

30. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
